'''Majjen''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the end of the conflict in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Majjen was assigned to judge the loyalty of former [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] officer [[Nick Rostu]]. In rejecting the offer, Rostu shot and killed Majjen and fled.
